summary: RadNet filed an 8-K reporting entry into Incremental Amendment No. 3 to its credit and guaranty agreement, adding a $250 million incremental term loan maturing April 18, 2031. The proceeds will fund future acquisitions, organic expansion, health system partnerships, and general corporate purposes. Interest rates were reduced by 0.25% to Term SOFR plus 2.00% or ABR plus 1.00%; quarterly principal payments increase to ~$3.1 million. The revolving credit facility of $282 million remains undrawn. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation, as it involves no change in control, acquisition, divestiture, or other transformative event.
